# GrainMotion-UI

> Fifty tactile UI controls made from simulated sand, stones, bamboo and walnut. The original four establish the physical design language: Slider, Toggle, Signature and Thinking. Phase 1 adds Checkbox, Radio Group, Segmented Control, Range Slider and Rating. Phase 2 adds Text Field, Textarea, Password Field, Search Field and OTP/PIN Input. Phase 3 adds Select/Dropdown, Combobox/Autocomplete, Date Picker, Date Range Picker and Time Picker. Phase 4 adds Progress Bar, Progress Ring, Step Indicator, Hourglass Timer and Loading Indicator. Phase 5 adds Tabs, Accordion, Pagination, Breadcrumbs and Menu / Popover. Phase 6 adds File Dropzone, Upload Queue, Image Carousel, Lightbox Gallery, Media Scrubber and Color Picker. Phase 7 adds Sortable List, Transfer List, Split Pane, Resizable Panels and Tree View. Phase 8 adds Tooltip, Toast Notification, Alert Banner, Dialog / Modal and Drawer / Sheet. Phase 9 adds Command Palette, Context Menu, Filter Builder, Data Table and Kanban Board. Every control is a standalone custom element with the sand engine and its required sound assets embedded. No runtime framework is required. MIT licensed.

Live gallery: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI
Source: https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI

## Drop-in controls

Each is one plain script that registers a custom element. Load it with a script tag, not as a module. Do not rewrite or split the file: the sounds (and the thinking state's rock) are inside it as data. Each file carries a copy of the shared engine; the first one loaded sets window.GrainMotionUI and the rest reuse it.

- [Slider](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/slider/slider.js): A slider that is a bamboo rake in a tray of sand. Drag right and its four tines cut grooves and push a little heap of sand ahead of it; pull back and its back drags the sand flat again. `<sand-slider>`: Use <sand-slider value="40" label="Volume"></sand-slider>. Read el.value; it fires input while it moves and change when it comes to rest. min, max and step work; with a name it is sent with its form. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/slider/README.md)
- [Toggle](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/toggle/toggle.js): A switch that is a river stone in a tray of raked sand. Switch it on and the stone glides along, parting the sand into a wake, and uncovers a power symbol it had pressed into the sand where it was resting. `<sand-toggle>`: Use <sand-toggle label="Focus mode"></sand-toggle>. Read el.checked and listen for change. Works in forms with a name. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/toggle/README.md)
- [Signature](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/signature/signature.js): A signature pad of smoothed sand, written in with a stick that cuts like a brush: linger and the line is wide and deep, hurry and it thins. The sand heaps up along the line. Clear sends a rake across that smooths it all away. `<sand-signature>`: Use <sand-signature name="signature"></sand-signature>. el.empty, el.undo(), el.clear() and el.toDataURL() give you the signature as ink on a transparent PNG; it fires input after each stroke. With a name its form gets the PNG. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/signature/README.md)
- [Thinking](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/thinking/thinking.js): An AI agent's working state as a rock in a round tray of sand that rakes itself. Thinking draws rings round the rock, searching draws spokes, using a tool draws lines that flow round it like water, and writing draws dashes like lines of text. `<sand-thinking>`: Use <sand-thinking state="thinking"></sand-thinking> and set el.state to thinking, searching, tool, writing or idle as your agent works. It is a status region, so the state is read out. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/thinking/README.md)
- [Checkbox](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/checkbox/checkbox.js): A checkbox where a small river stone rolls aside to reveal a checkmark etched into a circular sand well. `<sand-checkbox>`: Use <sand-checkbox label="Enable notifications" value="notifications"></sand-checkbox>. Read el.checked; it fires input and change when toggled. With a name, a checked value is submitted with its form. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/checkbox/README.md)
- [Radio Group](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/radio-group/radio-group.js): A radio group with individual stone wells and one selected pebble moving to the active option. `<sand-radio-group>`: Use <sand-radio-group name="size" label="Choose a size" options="Small,Medium,Large" value="Medium"></sand-radio-group>. Read el.value and listen for input/change. Options are comma-separated labels, up to five. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/radio-group/README.md)
- [Segmented Control](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/segmented/segmented.js): A segmented control where a flat river-stone marker glides across individually carved sections in a sand track. `<sand-segmented>`: Use <sand-segmented name="period" label="Time period" options="Day,Week,Month" value="Week"></sand-segmented>. Read el.value and listen for input/change. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/segmented/README.md)
- [Range Slider](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/range/range.js): A two-handle range slider with independently adjustable bamboo rake markers and a visibly disturbed selected interval. `<sand-range>`: Use <sand-range name="budget" label="Budget range" min="0" max="100" step="5" low="20" high="80"></sand-range>. Read el.low and el.high; el.value returns the pair. It fires input while adjusting and change when an interaction completes. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/range/README.md)
- [Rating](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/rating/rating.js): A five-point rating control where a selected river stone marks the chosen rating in one of five individual sand wells. `<sand-rating>`: Use <sand-rating name="product-rating" label="Product rating" value="4"></sand-rating>. Read el.value and listen for input/change. The supported scale is zero through five. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/rating/README.md)
- [Text Field](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/input/input.js): A native text input with a bamboo stylus-like focus marker and fine pressed guide line, retaining normal browser editing, selection and validation. `<sand-input>`: Use <sand-input name="displayName" label="Display name" placeholder="Your name"></sand-input>. Read or set el.value; native input and change events bubble from its internal input. Supported types are text, email, tel, url and search. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/input/README.md)
- [Textarea](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/textarea/textarea.js): A native multiline textarea over a wider sand tray, with shallow writing grooves and a moving stylus focus cue. `<sand-textarea>`: Use <sand-textarea name="message" label="Message" rows="4" maxlength="500"></sand-textarea>. Read or set el.value; native input and change events bubble from the internal textarea. Rows are clamped from 2 to 10. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/textarea/README.md)
- [Password Field](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/password/password.js): A native password input with a physical Show/Hide stone shutter. The value remains masked by default and is never printed in the demo status text. `<sand-password>`: Use <sand-password name="password" label="Password" autocomplete="current-password"></sand-password>. Read or set el.value. The revealed property or attribute toggles visibility; password is hidden by default. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/password/README.md)
- [Search Field](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/search/search.js): A native search input with a small search well, a clear button, an Enter-to-search event and a moving sand rake while busy. `<sand-search>`: Use <sand-search name="q" label="Search" placeholder="Search"></sand-search>. Pressing Enter dispatches a bubbling search event with detail.value. Set el.busy=true while your application fetches results; call el.clear() to reset. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/search/README.md)
- [OTP / PIN Input](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/otp/otp.js): A numeric OTP/PIN input drawn across individual engraved wells. One native input preserves mobile one-time-code autofill, paste, selection and keyboard behavior. `<sand-otp>`: Use <sand-otp name="verificationCode" label="Verification code" length="6" autocomplete="one-time-code" required></sand-otp>. Length is clamped from four to ten. The complete event exposes detail.length only, never the entered digits. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/otp/README.md)
- [Select / Dropdown](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/select/select.js): A native select control with a floating river stone and a carved chevron. The browser retains its familiar option popup, keyboard navigation and form semantics. `<sand-select>`: Use <sand-select name="delivery" label="Delivery speed" options="Standard,Express,Overnight" placeholder="Choose delivery"></sand-select>. Options are comma-separated; use value:Label for distinct submitted values and visible labels. Read or set el.value. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/select/README.md)
- [Combobox / Autocomplete](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/combobox/combobox.js): A native text input connected to a datalist for browser-managed suggestions. It permits free text, keyboard entry and paste while a small rake follows the query. `<sand-combobox>`: Use <sand-combobox name="city" label="City" options="DEL:Delhi,BLR:Bengaluru,HYD:Hyderabad" placeholder="Start typing"></sand-combobox>. The browser provides the datalist suggestion UI. Read or set el.value; free text is allowed. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/combobox/README.md)
- [Date Picker](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/date-picker/date-picker.js): A native date input over an engraved sand calendar. The value remains an ISO YYYY-MM-DD date string, with min, max and unavailable-day validation that avoids local timezone conversions. `<sand-date-picker>`: Use <sand-date-picker name="startDate" label="Start date" min="2026-01-01" max="2026-12-31" unavailable="2026-12-25"></sand-date-picker>. The value uses YYYY-MM-DD and is not converted through the local timezone. The native date picker handles calendar keyboard interaction. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/date-picker/README.md)
- [Date Range Picker](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/date-range/date-range.js): Two native date fields represent an inclusive calendar range. The component validates order, required endpoints, min/max bounds and unavailable days; it serializes complete ranges as start/end ISO strings. `<sand-date-range>`: Use <sand-date-range name="stay" start="2026-11-21" end="2026-11-25" min="2026-01-01" max="2026-12-31"></sand-date-range>. The value is `YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD`; start and end are separate properties. Dates are compared as calendar days, not local timestamps. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/date-range/README.md)
- [Time Picker](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/time-picker/time-picker.js): A native time input paired with a circular sand dial and deterministic 12/24-hour readout. Values remain timezone-free HH:MM strings; min, max and step use native time constraints. `<sand-time-picker>`: Use <sand-time-picker name="appointment" label="Appointment time" format="12" min="09:00" max="17:30" step="900"></sand-time-picker>. Read or set el.value in 24-hour `HH:MM` form. The `format` property controls a 12/24-hour readout; native input presentation follows browser locale. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/time-picker/README.md)
- [Progress Bar](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/progress/progress.js): A bamboo rake advances through a sand channel, leaving a growing trail and a soft ridge ahead of its tines. Supports determinate and indeterminate progress. `<sand-progress>`: Use <sand-progress value="42" label="Upload progress"></sand-progress>. Set value, min and max; add indeterminate for unknown progress. The element exposes progressbar semantics and aria-valuetext. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/progress/README.md)
- [Progress Ring](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/progress-ring/progress-ring.js): A circular progress indicator with a river pebble travelling around an engraved sand groove. Supports determinate and indeterminate states. `<sand-progress-ring>`: Use <sand-progress-ring value="68" label="Processing"></sand-progress-ring>. Set value, min and max, or add indeterminate for a looping marker. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/progress-ring/README.md)
- [Step Indicator](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/steps/steps.js): A multi-step indicator using stepping stones and native buttons. Completed, current and upcoming steps are visually distinct and keyboard operable. `<sand-steps>`: Use <sand-steps steps="Account,Details,Review,Done" value="1" label="Setup progress"></sand-steps>. Read or set value as a zero-based active step index. The element submits that index when name is supplied. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/steps/README.md)
- [Hourglass Timer](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/timer/timer.js): A countdown timer rendered as a two-chamber hourglass. Sand falls through a narrow waist; pause, resume, reset and cancel controls remain native buttons. `<sand-timer>`: Use <sand-timer duration="90" label="Break timer"></sand-timer>. Call start(), pause(), reset() or cancel(); read remaining and listen for timer-tick and complete. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/timer/README.md)
- [Loading Indicator](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/loader/loader.js): An indeterminate loading indicator with a miniature rake that loops through a recognizable sand pattern, distinct from the AI Thinking state. `<sand-loader>`: Use <sand-loader label="Loading results"></sand-loader>. Set active=false when work completes and speed to adjust the animation rate. Reduced motion holds the rake still. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/loader/README.md)
- [Tabs](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/tabs/tabs.js): A tactile tab system with a flat river-stone marker moving between carved tab wells. Real HTML tab buttons and content panels preserve native interaction and accessible semantics. `<sand-tabs>`: Use <sand-tabs tabs="overview:Overview,activity:Activity" value="overview"></sand-tabs>. Put template[data-panel] elements inside for real panel content. Read or set value and listen for the bubbling change event. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/tabs/README.md)
- [Accordion](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/accordion/accordion.js): An accordion made from walnut lids with small stone pulls. Opening a lid reveals a sand-toned compartment containing preserved native HTML content. `<sand-accordion>`: Use <sand-accordion items="shipping:Shipping,returns:Returns" value="shipping"></sand-accordion> with template[data-panel] children. Add multiple for simultaneous panels and collapsible to allow all panels to close. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/accordion/README.md)
- [Pagination](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/pagination/pagination.js): A pagination control with numbered sand wells and a moving river-stone page marker. Page state and navigation are native buttons; data loading remains the host application's responsibility. `<sand-pagination>`: Use <sand-pagination page="4" total="24"></sand-pagination>. Read or set page, configure sibling-count and boundary-count, and listen for change to load the selected page. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/pagination/README.md)
- [Breadcrumbs](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/breadcrumbs/breadcrumbs.js): A breadcrumb navigation trail with real ancestor links and a non-interactive current page marker. River stones sit along a shallow raked path. `<sand-breadcrumbs>`: Use <sand-breadcrumbs items="Home|/;Library|/library;Current"></sand-breadcrumbs>. Supply semicolon-separated Label|URL ancestors and a plain current label, or assign the items array property. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/breadcrumbs/README.md)
- [Menu / Popover](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/menu/menu.js): A compact command menu with a lifting stone trigger, anchored walnut tray, keyboard navigation, outside dismissal and focus restoration. Commands are emitted as events for the host application. `<sand-menu>`: Use <sand-menu items="new:New project,duplicate:Duplicate"></sand-menu>. Listen for the bubbling select event to run an action. The open property and attribute control the menu visibility. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/menu/README.md)
- [File Dropzone](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/dropzone/dropzone.js): A file dropzone with real drag-and-drop and native file selection, type and size checks, clearable file state and accessible rejection messages. A file tile settles into a sand tray when accepted. `<sand-dropzone>`: Use <sand-dropzone accept="image/*,.pdf" multiple max-size="10485760" label="Project files"></sand-dropzone>. Read files, call addFiles() or clear(), and listen for files-change and file-reject. max-size is in bytes; the component selects files but does not upload them. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/dropzone/README.md)
- [Upload Queue](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/upload-queue/upload-queue.js): A transport-agnostic upload queue with per-file progress, queued/uploading/complete/error/cancelled states, retry and removal controls. It emits requests so the host application can perform the actual transfer. `<sand-upload-queue>`: Use <sand-upload-queue label="Uploads"></sand-upload-queue>. Call addFiles(files), update(id, {status, progress, error}), remove(id) or clear(). Listen for upload-request, upload-cancel, retry-request and queue-change. The host application owns the network transfer. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/upload-queue/README.md)
- [Image Carousel](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/carousel/carousel.js): An image carousel that displays real images in a recessed walnut frame with previous/next buttons, indexed selection, touch swipes and keyboard navigation. It never fetches or transforms image sources. `<sand-carousel>`: Set el.items to an array of {src, alt, caption} objects. Read or set el.index and listen for change. Only HTTP(S), blob and data:image sources are accepted. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/carousel/README.md)
- [Lightbox Gallery](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/lightbox/lightbox.js): A thumbnail gallery with a native modal dialog for expanded images, accessible previous/next navigation, Escape/backdrop dismissal and focus restoration. `<sand-lightbox>`: Set el.items to {src, alt, caption} objects. Call openAt(index, opener) or close(), and listen for open, change and close. The expanded viewer uses the native dialog element. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/lightbox/README.md)
- [Media Scrubber](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/scrubber/scrubber.js): A media timeline bound to an existing HTMLAudioElement or HTMLVideoElement, with play/pause, current position, buffered range visualization and keyboard-accessible seeking. `<sand-scrubber>`: Assign el.media = document.querySelector('video') or an audio element. The scrubber does not fetch media; it reads duration/currentTime/buffered and writes currentTime when seeking. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/scrubber/README.md)
- [Color Picker](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/color-picker/color-picker.js): A color control with the native browser color dialog and a palette of tactile mineral swatches. Supports hexadecimal, RGB and HSL readouts plus form submission. `<sand-color-picker>`: Use <sand-color-picker name="accent" value="#c28b55" format="hex"></sand-color-picker>. Read or set value; input and change events expose both formatted value and normalized hex. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/color-picker/README.md)
- [Sortable List](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/sortable/sortable.js): A reorderable list with native drag-and-drop, keyboard shortcuts and explicit move buttons. Ordering is stored as stable item IDs and exposed through a property and events. `<sand-sortable>`: Set items to an array of {id,label,disabled} objects. Read value for the ordered IDs or call move(fromIndex,toIndex). Native dragging, arrow keys and Move Up/Down buttons are supported. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/sortable/README.md)
- [Transfer List](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/transfer-list/transfer-list.js): A two-sided transfer control with multi-selection, explicit move-selected and move-all actions, and stable item IDs. The host owns the data and persistence. `<sand-transfer-list>`: Set items to {id,label,side,disabled} objects. Select IDs through the selected property, then call move(ids,'left'|'right'), moveSelected(target) or moveAll(target). [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/transfer-list/README.md)
- [Split Pane](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/split-pane/split-pane.js): A two-pane horizontal or vertical layout with a pointer-draggable separator, keyboard resizing, minimum and maximum bounds, and slotted host content. `<sand-split-pane>`: Place child elements in slot="start" and slot="end". Set value as the first pane percentage, axis to horizontal or vertical, and configure min-size/max-size. Listen for input and change. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/split-pane/README.md)
- [Resizable Panels](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/resizable/resizable.js): A multi-panel layout with two to four panels, adjacent resizable boundaries, keyboard controls, minimum and maximum proportions, and serializable panel sizes. `<sand-resizable>`: Assign panels as an array of {id,label,content,min,max} objects. Read or set sizes as percentages and call resizeBoundary(index,delta) to adjust an adjacent pair. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/resizable/README.md)
- [Tree View](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/tree/tree.js): A nested tree with expansion state, single-node selection, visible-node keyboard navigation and accessible treeitem semantics. `<sand-tree>`: Assign nested items with id, label and children. Read or set value and expanded, or call select(id) and toggle(id). Arrow keys navigate and expand/collapse branches. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/tree/README.md)
- [Tooltip](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/tooltip/tooltip.js): A non-interactive tooltip anchored to a trigger by element ID, with pointer and keyboard activation, Escape dismissal, configurable placement and delay, and aria-describedby token preservation. `<sand-tooltip>`: Use the for attribute to reference a trigger element ID and text for the hint. Set placement and delay, or read/write open and call show() or hide(). [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/tooltip/README.md)
- [Toast Notification](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/toast/toast.js): A timed notification with status or alert semantics, action and dismiss controls, timer pausing on hover/focus, and independent corner stacking. `<sand-toast>`: Call show(message?) and dismiss(reason?) or set open. Configure title, message, tone, duration, position and action-label. Listen for action and dismiss events. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/toast/README.md)
- [Alert Banner](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/alert/alert.js): A persistent status banner with tone-aware live-region semantics, optional title, action and dismissal. It stays visible until the host or user dismisses it. `<sand-alert>`: Set tone, title, message, dismissible and action-label. Call dismiss() or show(), and listen for action and dismiss events. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/alert/README.md)
- [Dialog / Modal](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/dialog/dialog.js): A native modal dialog custom element that preserves caller content, traps focus through the browser top layer, supports Escape and optional backdrop dismissal, and restores opener focus. `<sand-dialog>`: Set open or call showModal()/show(). Use close(returnValue), title, description, confirm-label, cancel-label and dismissal policy attributes. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/dialog/README.md)
- [Drawer / Sheet](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/drawer/drawer.js): A responsive modal sheet that slides from the left, right, top or bottom, uses native dialog focus containment, and provides Escape/backdrop and action controls. `<sand-drawer>`: Set open or call showModal()/show(). Configure placement, size, title and description; close(returnValue) and listen for drawer-open, drawer-close and confirm. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/drawer/README.md)
- [Command Palette](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/command/command.js): A keyboard-first searchable command palette with native modal focus containment, filtering, active result navigation and host-facing command events. `<sand-command>`: Set commands to records with id, label, description, keywords, shortcut and disabled. Call show(), hide(reason) or run(id); read value and listen for command, select, command-open and command-close. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/command/README.md)
- [Context Menu](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/context-menu/context-menu.js): A context menu anchored to a target element or built-in demo surface, opened by right-click, long-press or keyboard shortcut, with viewport-aware positioning and keyboard navigation. `<sand-context-menu>`: Set items to action records and optionally set the for attribute to a target ID. Listen for menu-open, select/menu-select and menu-close. The host executes the selected action. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/context-menu/README.md)
- [Filter Builder](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/filter-builder/filter-builder.js): A structured filter editor with configurable fields, operators and values, AND/OR logic, add/remove/reset operations and a serializable query contract. `<sand-filter-builder>`: Set fields and filters as properties, select AND or OR through logic, and listen for input, change, apply and reset. toQuery() returns the host-facing query object. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/filter-builder/README.md)
- [Data Table](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/table/table.js): A searchable, sortable and selectable data table with stable row IDs, column visibility, multi-selection, sticky headings and bounded client-side pagination. `<sand-table>`: Set columns and rows as properties; read selected, page and pageSize. Set filter, sortBy and sortDirection, call sort(key), select(id, checked), selectVisible(ids, checked) and listen for sort, filter, select, change and row-activate. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/table/README.md)
- [Kanban Board](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/kanban/kanban.js): A multi-column Kanban board with stable card and column IDs, native drag-and-drop, explicit move buttons, arrow-key movement, priority labels and host-facing move/select events. `<sand-kanban>`: Set columns to records containing id, label and cards. Call moveCard(cardId, columnId, index) or action(cardId, direction); listen for move, change and select events. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/blob/main/kanban/README.md)

Install any one with the shadcn CLI: `npx shadcn add Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI/NAME`, where NAME is slider, toggle, signature, thinking, checkbox, radio-group, segmented, range, rating, input, textarea, password, search, otp, select, combobox, date-picker, date-range, time-picker, progress, progress-ring, steps, timer, loader, tabs, accordion, pagination, breadcrumbs, menu, dropzone, upload-queue, carousel, lightbox, scrubber, color-picker, sortable, transfer-list, split-pane, resizable, tree, tooltip, toast, alert, dialog, drawer, command, context-menu, filter-builder, table, kanban. The file lands in `public/grainmotion-ui/`.

Each scales to its CSS width and needs WebGL2 to draw. They are drawn for a light page. Sound plays after the first touch or key on the page; GrainMotionUI.Sound.on = false silences them all. They do not stop moving for prefers-reduced-motion.

## The skill

- [grainmotion-ui skill](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/skills/grainmotion-ui/SKILL.md): how the set was made and the rules it follows. Install with `npx skills add Brajesh31/GrainMotion-UI`.
- [core.js](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/skills/grainmotion-ui/core.js): the sand engine (height field, slumping, raked lines, the GPU lighting, stones, sound).
- [starter.html](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/skills/grainmotion-ui/starter.html): the smallest whole example, a tray you draw in with your finger.
- [look.mjs](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/skills/grainmotion-ui/look.mjs): drives a page with a slowed CPU, measures frame times and saves frames side by side.

## How it was made

- [making-of/README.md](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/making-of/README.md): the idea, how the sand works, and the corrections that shaped each control.
- [making-of/prompts.md](https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI/making-of/prompts.md): every image and sound prompt, in order.
